approved_increase.notes: Average 10.95% electricity increase confirmed in effect from 1 July 2026 by the metro's own post-1-July public notice (Ward 9 councillor: 'The approved average increases are: Electricity: 10.95%') and Daily Maverick (2 June 2026). CONFLICT RESOLVED (2026-07-05 recheck): The Citizen's 10.09% was literally the top of a quoted range ('between 8.63% and 10.09%'), i.e. a benchmark band, not a rival approved figure. Metro total revenue requirement 2026/27: R9.26bn.
